static_traits.name: Wang Jie
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar problems before; never received psychotherapy or counseling
static_traits.language_features: clear expression, fairly good logic, able to describe automatic thoughts and emotions specifically;Positive attitude but slightly tense; tending to negate positive feedback and mental filtering when praised, fairly cooperative.

basic_info.main_problem: despite often being praised by others for intelligence and ability, I strongly resist becoming the center of attention. This makes me feel discomfort and aversion when recognized, and hard to cope in Social situations.
basic_info.core_demands: discomfort in Social situations and the persistent tendency to negate positive feedback are affecting my Interpersonal relationships and self-esteem, so seeking counseling to ease these effects.
growth_experiences: praised by others for intelligence and ability continuously since childhood, gradually developing discomfort and aversion toward being noticed and praised; recently more attention from personal achievements worsened this discomfort and began affecting relationships with friends, colleagues and self-esteem.

core_beliefs: I must be perfect; otherwise I am a failure
being noticed and praised is unsafe and makes me very uncomfortable

special_situations.event: Publicly praised by friends or colleagues for intelligence or achievements in social occasions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I accept praise, I will become the focus of everyone and be judged
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: downplaying or ignoring positive feedback, Displacing topics, avoiding eye contact
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should not be noticed, I hate being the focus

special_situations.event: Receiving more attention at work or in team meetings for completing a project
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: once noticeable,Interpersonal relationships become tense with pickiness and judgment
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces self-exposure, pushes credit onto others to reduce attention

special_situations.event: eating food not in the plan during dieting
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: one mistake means complete failure, proving I have no self-control
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Skips meals and does extreme exercise to punish oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never reach my goal

special_situations.event: Recalls and repeatedly focuses on a dietary lapse
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I cannot control myself, and will keep failing in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forces oneself to follow the plan through harsh self-criticism
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This failure proves I will fail in the future too

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and recognized while maintaining safe self-boundaries
core_conflict.fear: fear of being judged after becoming the focus,Interpersonal tension and losing a sense of control
defense_goal: reducing anxiety by downplaying praise and avoiding the spotlight
maintaining 'a sense of control' through self-punishment and Undoing guilt

object_relations.self_representation: an individual unwilling to be the focus, prone to discomfort when watched
object_relations.object_representation: Others are overly attentive praisers who may judge

object_relations.self_representation: A person out of control who fails easily and needs to punish oneself
object_relations.object_representation: Others (or an inner harsh parent figure) are critical, strictly demanding judges

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When affirmed for strengths in counseling or invited to focus on one's own achievements
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Unconsciously believes the counselor will push her into the spotlight and judge her (transference: seeing others as judgmental watchers)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: downplaying praise, responding with Self-deprecation or Displacing topics, restrained tone, reducing detail disclosure to avoid becoming the focus.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing eating mistakes or when black-and-white thinking is pointed out
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets the counselor's inquiries as criticism and control (transference: imagining others as harsh supervisors)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: using analytical, abstract language, weakening emotional wording, keeping a calm objective tone to avoid shame and guilt.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When guilt and shame rise and one thinks of one's own 'mistakes'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes one must atone through self-punishment to avoid worse consequences
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expresses in self-blaming statements, proposes punitive plans (such as skipping meals, increasing exercise intensity), harsh tone, little attention to self-care.

manifestations: unwilling to be the focus, avoiding or downplaying others' praise and attention
even with several close friends, not yet discussing this issue, tending to bear the discomfort alone
When recognized, feels shame and tension, reducing genuine contact with others

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Downplays or ignores positive feedback when praised
Displacing topics to avoid directly responding to praise or recognition

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: After dietary slips, over-blames oneself and takes extreme punishment
being overly cautious in social responses, Repressing true expression for fear of judgment

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: treating 'must be perfect, cannot make mistakes' as an absolute standard
When praised or recognized, takes external expectations as the standard and ignores his own feelings

exception_events.target_problem: when dietary temptations or deviations occur, the client usually catastrophizes emotionally, believing oneself 'a complete failure', and self-punishes by skipping meals or extreme exercise, worsening stress and unhealthy eating patterns.
exception_events.unique_outcome: the client once strictly followed the diet plan for a stretch and felt Good about progress, not yet dominated by the 'one mistake equals failure' thought.
exception_events.reason: clues: during that period, she focused more on success evidence and actual progress, maintaining a steady pace; possibly did advance planning and self-recording, thus boosting Self-efficacy.

positive_force: Intelligence and ability are continually recognized by others (has objective advantages)
Once successfully stuck to a diet plan for a period, with experience of self-discipline and self-efficacy
Has several trustworthy close friends who can provide emotional support
Willing to try behavioral experiments and cognitive restructuring, clear help-seeking motivation
negative_force: tending to negate positive feedback (Disqualifying the Positive)
Mental filtering, focusing on the negative and ignoring successful experiences (Mental Filtering)
All-or-nothing thinking and negative prediction lead to one mistake being judged as total failure
fearing becoming the focus, avoiding praise and attention, affecting Interpersonal relationships
Self-punishment behaviors driven by guilt and shame (skipping meals, extreme exercise), worsening health and emotions

target_behavior.behavior: avoiding/downplaying praise when praised or noticed, accompanied by intense discomfort
antecedent: Being praised by friends or colleagues for intelligence or achievements in social settings
Receiving more attention due to personal achievements
target_behavior.core_reason: early continuous praise forming the conditional belief that 'being noticed is unsafe/will be judged', and Highly sensitive to external evaluation
target_behavior.function: escaping the discomfort and anxiety of being noticed and judged
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension, worsening discomfort in social settings, affecting self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: self-punishing after dietary deviations (skipping meals, extreme exercise), with despair and sense of failure
antecedent: eating food not in the plan
target_behavior.core_reason: The black-and-white core assumption that 'one error equals total failure', together with pessimistic predictions about self-control
target_behavior.function: trying to Recover a sense of control through punishing behaviors, Undoing guilt and shame
target_behavior.consequence: Increased stress, worsening eating patterns, negative emotion Reinforcement, further weakening self-efficacy and health
